summary: Read a table of m rows and n columns. Every cell holds an integer that is zero or positive. Start on the northwest cell and finish on the southeast cell. Each step may land only on the neighboring cell to the south or the neighboring cell to the east. Add the integer in every cell you touch, including the start and the finish. Find the smallest total among all routes and write that total. When several routes share that smallest total, writing the total is enough.
notes: Compare after trimming trailing newlines. The input is tokens in the same order as the method parameters.
